opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Waite

delivered the opinion of the court.

This suit is dismissed on the authority of Hecht v. Boughton, So. 912, of this term, 105 U. S. 235. The remedy is by appeal instead of a writ of error. Affirmed,.
